narrationTexts: Confirms the bug: `orderTotal` taxes the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount.
finalText:
**Fixed — suite is green, 625/625 passing.**

`orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:39](src/pricing.js:39) was taxing the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one. Only 3 of 625 cases caught it, all where both discount and tax were non-zero.

Nothing left to do.
